dialogue.line: I'm sorry. This is the only way.
Get the hell outta here. You deaf? I said get the--
I'm gonna go look for my wife.
Someone's gotta make sure that Jim comes back in one piece.
I know what it's like to lose a parent here,
and I'm not gonna watch Julie and Ethan lose
both their parents in the same week.
We could just start from here in the morning.
-Just give me a second. - Come on!
My stomach just hasn't been right.
Those animals are the only food that we have now.
They are a resource. We have to make everything last!
There's goddamn cows in the street!
Get those smaller animals into the barn!
No, no, no! You go back!
You think this place can't break you?
No, no, no, no, no, no, no!
No, no, no, no, no, no! I know, I know, I know!
I know! I know! I know!
Somebody has to go and see.
They left it in my pocket.
It's growing in patches all around the lake.
There's enough food here to feed everybody in the entire town.
You passed out on my front porch.
Okay. Okay. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
You showed up on my doorstep
with the lunchbox my son left here with...
So, you're gonna tell me how you found that,
and you're gonna tell me right now.
My family and I were on a road trip
to see some relatives in Colorado,
when we had to take a detour off the highway.
There was a massive tree in the middle of the road,
so we thought we were just driving around it.
But we never got back to the road.
We kept driving, and-- and we got to this... town,
a place that we couldn't leave.
and some of them had been there for a while.
I don't know how long they'd been--
No, no! Where did you get the lunchbox?
Well, that's what I'm trying to tell you.
there are people that had been there for years, I mean, for--
Where did you get the lunchbox?!
Your son. Victor. He--he gave it to me.
Oh. He gave it to you.
Victor is alive. The town I was telling you about,
he's been stuck there all these years.
If you won't talk to me, then maybe you'll talk to the police.
No, sir. Please, please. You can't call them.
I can't tell them who I am.
If I try to explain any of this to them, I'll sound crazy.
When they ask where my family is...
what am I gonna tell them? I don't--
I don't know where they are.
Please, sir, you have to believe me.
I called the police about 20 minutes ago.
They should be here any minute.
So, we're just gonna sit here together...
I know how to prove I'm not lying.
No. You don't come in here. You understand?
Boyd might be okay with everything you did,
but if you think for a second--
Something happened last night. The animals...
got out into the street, and she...
I didn't... I thought you would want to know,
and I wasn't sure if anyone...
We need to make sure she gets buried with her husband.
You were in the barn with her, with those things.
I just... I don't think that a good idea right now, okay?
She's gonna be okay, right? Kristi can fix her.
We should bring her her blanket.
She'll be more comfortable when she has her blanket.
Tell her that we have to go see Tian-Chen!
I could use a little help in there.
- You... You have to go? - Yes, I have to go.
-Hey, hey! I'm talking to you! -I have to go!
We can't help her! She's dead!
I told you that! It's not make-believe!
I told you that bad things happen here!
It's not my fault that you didn't listen!
I mean, there's other people you can look up.
Boyd Stevens. His family went missing.
Liu! Liu! Tian-Chen and Kenny Liu.
That family-- that family's there, too.
I don't know how you're doing this, but you're lying.
No, no. No, no, no, no, no.
I swear to you I'm not.
I swear on my children's lives.
My family is trapped, and Victor is trapped, too.
Then how did you get here, huh?
You want me to believe you just happen to be the one person
who somehow managed to escape this terrifying place?
Listen, I don't understand, but yes, yes.
He's nice and sweet, and my son loves him.
And my daughter... He saved my daughter's life.
if I saved the children locked in the tower, then...
somehow, I could save her from whatever's happening to her--
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. What did you say?
Well, when I was in town, I started seeing children,
or at least imagining I was.
Victor said that they were children locked in the tower,
that if I saved them, then maybe I could--
I could somehow help my daughter from what she's going through,
and I don't know if I'm doing it--
Please. Don't let them in. Please.
I'm not lying. I'm not lying.
I screwed up, man. I thought I had an intruder
and turned out to be just a dog off the leash.
Look, I owe you a dozen, okay? I'm sorry.
All right, Henry. Take care of yourself.
Yeah, you, too. Yeah, I'm sorry.
I, uh, bought that almost 40 years ago...
a few years after my family disappeared.
I never once had the courage to even load it, much less...
I'm gonna make you something to eat.
They knew we'd go after the animals.
and just waited for us to walk right to them.
How many did you save? Was it worth it?
How much better off are we today than we were yesterday?
Are you saying that I had a choice?
No, Boyd! We are all we have!
That is all we've got, and now we've got one less!
So, what was-- what was I supposed to do?!
watching our only resource go wandering off into the woods?
We would have found another way!
Yesterday you were ready to crawl into a fucking hole
And now you're standing there, telling me
that we would have found another way?!
That I shoulda just-- I shoulda--
That I should just-- get the fuck outta here!
-What the fuck am I-- -No, okay, No, you're right.
You're right. You did what you had to do.
You did the only thing you could do.
...because the game here is fucking rigged.
And no matter what hand you play, you lose.
I'm not angry at you, Boyd.
because you told us that, someday, we'd go home...
...and I was stupid enough to believe it.
We gotta dress that cow before the meat spoils.
Hey. You been in there for a while.
-Yeah, I'm fine. -You know, I was thinking,
maybe we should go see Kristi, uh, just as a precaution.
Can you at least open the door?
You know, why don't I go see if Kristi
can just come up here, and that way, you can just stay?
You're not sleeping. You're barely eating.
Fatima? Hey, look, come on. What's going on?
Fatima, you're scaring me. Come on.
Can you please open the door?
Uh, I think you're right. Maybe we should go see Kristi.
Uh, she's... She's down in town.
She's taking the news about Tian-Chen pretty hard.
Come on in. I'll take a look at you.
You know what? Maybe we should wait for Kristi.
Kristi's dealing with a lot right now.
Look, no offense. You're not a doctor.
I am, however, a pediatric nurse.
So, as far as pregnancy goes,
Kinda cold out for a swim.
What are you doing out here?
I can't even remember whose truck this was.
And his, um-- his girlfriend Shay.
You know, with all due respect, Kristi,
I'm... not here for a pep talk.
All due respect, Boyd, I don't really give a shit.
Look, after what happened with Sara,
when she tried to hurt Ethan...
you sat with me in that diner
and you told me it wasn't my fault,
that I had saved a lot of lives, and that I was gonna save
a hell of a lot more by the time this all was finished.
So, was that just a bunch of bullshit
to make me feel better, or did you mean it?
Hey. This isn't your fault. Okay?
Now, come on. Let's go get you cleaned up.
There's a--there's a lake, and it's got everything.
There might even be fish in the water!
Kenny, maybe we should go inside.
-Hey, Kenny-- -Stop! No, no, no, no, no.
-Listen, I'm so-- -No, no! Stop! Just--just stop.
It's okay. It's okay. It's okay. I'm okay.
I just... I need to sit here for a minute.
When was the last time you ate?
It's just even the smell of food,
Look, are you sure we shouldn't just get Kristi?
or since this place... mind-raped me?
Look, I know this is scary,
you're doing exactly what you're supposed to be doing.
In the tradition of first-time fathers everywhere,
you're scared out of your mind,
and you're asking every question you possibly can.
As for you, you're severely malnourished.
It's a wonder only one tooth fell out.
You also may have something called hyperemesis gravidarum.
What is that? Is that bad?
It's essentially really bad morning sickness.
We really just need to get you eating again.
Well, you tell that to the world's pickiest eater.
I'm gonna see if maybe we have something
But as far as the baby?
-Everything's okay? -As far as I can tell,
Ah, you see? I told you.
Yeah, yeah, it was totally me, you know,
You hear that in there? Everything's gonna be okay.
Whenever things got really bad here, she'd...
we'll never have this day again."
to make sure I got the message.
It's okay. You don't have to...
Have you seen what they did to her?
Whenever I think about my dad...
All I can see is him lying there in that basement.
I can't think of him and not see him like that.
I don't want it to be like that for her.
Can you do me a favor?
Can you make her look like her?
Can you make sure she looks nice?
You, um... You need anything at all,
anything, you get someone to come get me, okay?
Fucking stop! Shut the fuck up!
Julie, whatever you're feeling right now,
What the fuck is wrong with you?
You should have been here, Dad.
I... I can't. I can't be like before.
Hey, hold on. What are you talking about?
I can't be the fill-in parent while you lose your shit.
I was looking for your mother.
Mom is gone! Okay? She's gone!
She went through a tree, and now she's gone!
Dad...people can't survive more than a few hours at night
She's been gone four days. I know--
I know you feel bad that you didn't stop her, but I can't...
When Thomas died, you and Mom fell apart,
and there was no one there for Ethan.
I need you to get your shit together. Okay?
I don't get a lot of visitors.
At least now I know you won't pass out on me.
Back before she disappeared, my wife, Miranda,
She said they were children, calling out to her,
you know, crying out to be saved.
The only person I ever repeated that to
When you're done, I-I wanna show you something.
I want you to look at this room.
This is where my children slept.
They were the lights of my life.
it ripped my life to pieces.
I didn't care about the accusations.
I didn't care that everyone thought that I did it.
all I could think, all I could... remember,
is that the last words I said to them,
And then, I went to work.
When I came home... they were gone.
Why are you showing me this?
I don't know how you know
about those children my wife heard.
I don't know how you got a hold of my son's lunchbox or...
or how you could have possibly faked those articles online.
telling the truth, and that means my son is alive.
I don't even have the words to... express.
So, if you, if this isn't real...
If this is all just some cruel, elaborate--
No, no, no, no, no. I swear to you, it's not.
I believe that the reason I was sent here...
I think you're here for what's in the basement.
I didn't want her to be alone.
I'll... I'll give you some time.
fix her before Kenny sees her,
and I don't know how to do that.
I used to play dress-up a lot as a kid.
All right, let's get you inside--whoa,
See if Marielle's magic elixir does the trick, okay?
Why don't you go see your dad?
All I gotta do is get in bed,
and he's having a really hard day.
Yeah. Go. Go. I love you.
None of these are any good. They're all gross.
Yeah. We figured we'd try composting them,
see if we can't get the soil turned around.
-You think that'll work? -Who the hell knows?
It's okay. Everyone's on, uh, on edge these days, so...
Still, no reason to be a dick. Sorry.
Ethan, what are you doing up here?
He's not in his room. He was pretty upset.
Is that the cow that died from last night?
I've never seen what things look like on the inside before.
Is that what Tian-Chen looked like...
after what they did to her?
and it looks so different outside.
Hey, how about you and me--
When I worked at the diner,
We used to try on dresses sometimes,

I'm gonna do, and that's it.
I don't wanna talk. I don't wanna listen.
Kenny, what are the bottles for?
and I'm gonna burn every last fucking one of them.

-The last one was already dead. -I don't care.
I'm gonna make those fucking things hurt.
Victor and Tabitha said they're, uh,
What he didn't see-- creatures, not a single one.
Do you still think they're down there?
Maybe they went somewhere else after Tabitha
and Victor found them or maybe they went deeper in.
This is one thing I do know.
This is how they want us --
angry, stumbling around in the dark.
there's a good chance we are not coming back.

I will go with you, side by side,
and we will take out as many of those motherfuckers as we can.
how alone she must have felt.

hey, they made me watch. They made me watch.

before-- before she died, she said...

do you think her makeup's okay?

Tian-Chen might sit up and slap the lipstick out of your hand.
I just--I just--I just want it to be right for Kenny.

and I'm scared of what that might mean.

Well, believe it or not, it all started on my birthday.

but we gave up all the drugs,
all the drinking when she got pregnant with Victor.

Miranda gets it in her head

She gets us two hits of acid.
We take the kids to her parents' house for the night,
and we take one last trip for old times' sake.
She said it was like she'd been chosen.
She said it was a place
that was everywhere, but you couldn't find it if you tried.
Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

but never find a way to leave.

...who found themselves living inside a nightmare
...fighting a battle they knew they couldn't win.

who would find their way to this place,
she was the one who had been chosen to free the children.

if they've called to you, then I guess...

carry a lot of weight from this place,
